about.title: Miriam Rossini
about.lead: Technique, sensitivity and close attention to every client's individuality.
about.text: A Brazilian artist based in Portugal, Miriam brings a warm and thoughtful approach to lash design. Every appointment begins by listening and ends with a result that respects your natural features.

comparison.title:
A visible change.
A delicate result.
comparison.text: A thoughtful design opens up the eyes while preserving your natural expression.

faq.title: Before you book.
faq.q1: How do I choose the right effect?
faq.a1: At the start of your appointment, Miriam assesses your eye shape, natural lashes and desired result to recommend a personalised design.
faq.a2: Retention varies with your natural lash cycle and aftercare. Maintenance timing is recommended individually.
faq.q3: How should I care for my lashes?
faq.a3: After your appointment, you will receive specific cleaning and maintenance guidance to care for your lashes safely.
